step.label: Receive and validate customer order
step.description: Capture incoming customer order and verify fulfillment eligibility against customer master data and order history.
step.useCase: Sales team receives a new customer order and confirms it can be fulfilled based on account standing and delivery capability.

step.label: Analyze vendor spend and procurement strategy
step.description: Review historical spend patterns and vendor performance to optimize material sourcing decisions for the order.
step.useCase: Procurement analyst evaluates which vendors offer the best cost and quality for required materials.

step.label: Procure required materials from vendors
step.description: Execute purchase orders with selected vendors and manage vendor relationships to ensure material availability.
step.useCase: Procurement officer creates and tracks purchase orders with preferred vendors to secure bill-of-materials components.

step.label: Coordinate vendor delivery and inventory intake
step.description: Manage purchase order fulfillment and vendor communication to ensure materials arrive on schedule for production.
step.useCase: Inventory manager coordinates with vendors to confirm delivery dates and updates warehouse receipt systems.

step.label: Release production order to manufacturing
step.description: Translate customer order into production order and allocate machines and resources to begin manufacturing.
step.useCase: Production planner creates work orders and schedules machines to manufacture the ordered products.

step.label: Execute engineering change management
step.description: Assess and apply any material or design modifications required during production to align with customer specifications or standards.
step.useCase: Engineering team automates material substitutions or design revisions needed mid-production run.

step.label: Allocate workforce and manage payroll impact
step.description: Assign production staff to manufacturing tasks and calculate labor costs to support accurate order costing and payroll processing.
step.useCase: HR manager ensures production team members are assigned and their labor hours are tracked for payroll and cost accounting.

step.label: Investigate production incidents and root causes
step.description: Identify and resolve safety or operational issues that arise during manufacturing to maintain schedule and prevent recurrence.
step.useCase: Safety coordinator addresses equipment failure or process anomaly detected on production floor and documents corrective actions.
